title: Connection with Miao Miao and Huawei P20 Pro fails constantly
symptom: Bluetooth connection failures between the Miao Miao and Huawei P20 Pro constantly, despite testing several versions of Xdrip.
fix: Turning off Trust Autoconnect in xDrip settings - less common settings - Bluetooth settings was the solution.
evidence_quote: I found that turning off Trust Autoconnect was the solution.
